The footer stamp 'SBL-0033 Rev. No:2 Date: 19.12.2025' was not used, since it carries its own revision/date and reads as a document/form control stamp rather than this product's drawing number.

This 'LTRM' drawing mirrors sibling 'RTRM' drawing DE8114: DE8114 (RTRM) terminates only the right BUS end using R10 while skipping R9; this drawing (LTRM) terminates only the left BUS end using R9 while R10 is absent, the same family-wide numbering pattern confirmed on the 3-stub pair (DE8113/DE8123).

Front view silkscreen labels GND, J2 BUS, J3 STUB, J4 STUB, J5 STUB, and J6 STUB identify connector positions (no J1 BUS label; the left terminal is only shown internally in the schematic via R9) but are not a pin-to-value or labeled table structure, so they were not extracted as a table.

The recommended land pattern shows a staggered two-row arrangement of 11 holes/pads total; the exact split of the 11 pads between the two rows is not fully resolvable from the printed dimensions alone.
No GD&T feature control frames, datum references, or +/- tolerance callouts were visible on this sheet; tolerances left empty.
